variants.name: 水墨留白
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one complete standalone iOS app icon for 竹影 (Zhuying), a quiet personal book reading app.
Output: one square 1024x1024 opaque image. Production icon art itself, edge-to-edge square background; no pre-rounded corners, no frame, no text, no Chinese characters, no letters, no watermark, no device or presentation board, no extra icon samples. Centered strong silhouette readable at small app sizes, generous edge margins.
Primary request: A serene contemporary Chinese ink-painting app icon with expressive brush character and meaningful negative space.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed warm ivory rice-paper field, #F4EFE3, very subtle paper grain.
Subject: a single bold deep forest-green bamboo sprig with two broad tapered leaves, painted with masterful fluid brush gestures. Its lower curved brushstroke suggests one turning book page in negative space, a subtle reading allusion rather than a literal detailed open book. Use 3 to 5 confident strokes maximum. Elegant asymmetric balance within a centered composition. Dark ink pigment variation within broad strokes, carefully controlled organic edges; ink should feel hand-brushed.
Style: restrained contemporary literati ink art distilled into an iconic brand mark. Airy, intelligent, warm, contemplative.
Color palette: ivory paper, deep pine-green ink #244936, one small muted cinnabar circular accent with no characters, placed as a balancing punctuation.
Composition: main bamboo mark about 64% of canvas height; prominent open ivory space. All important forms clear of the corners. No scenic illustration, no realistic forest, no mountains, no tiny leaf clusters, no hairline stems, no enclosing circle, no broad green background, no glossy or 3D treatment.

variants.name: 现代几何
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one complete standalone iOS app icon for 竹影 (Zhuying), a quiet personal book reading app.
Output: one square 1024x1024 opaque image. Production icon art itself, edge-to-edge square background; no pre-rounded corners, no frame, no text, no Chinese characters, no letters, no watermark, no device or presentation board, no extra icon samples. Centered strong silhouette readable at small app sizes, generous edge margins.
Primary request: A striking flat geometric app icon, designed as a bold contemporary symbol with impeccable optical geometry.
Scene/backdrop: uniform full-bleed saturated jade-green #087E65 background.
Subject: ONE abstract warm-ivory emblem constructed from two interlocking angular bamboo-leaf parallelograms and a clean folded book-page wedge. The negative space forms a distinctive diagonal path like a page turning. Compact, confident, balanced near-square silhouette; clever leaf-and-page dual meaning without drawing a literal book with a sprout. 3 solid shapes maximum. Broad surfaces, crisp straight edges with a few precisely rounded outer corners, intentional positive-negative space. Emblem occupies about 58-64% of canvas width.
Style: pure flat vector-like graphic identity, Swiss modernism meets contemporary East Asian editorial design. Energetic, memorable, simple enough to draw from memory, excellent readability at 32px.
Color palette: bright deep jade #087E65 and warm ivory #FFF6DE, with a tiny citron green #D1E771 fold accent only if the mark benefits from it.
Avoid: gradients, texture, lighting, cast shadows, 3D, paper grain, brush strokes, literal open-book-plus-growing-plant composition, outlines, tiny details, circles or decorative badges.

variants.name: 立体纸雕
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one complete standalone iOS app icon for 竹影 (Zhuying), a quiet personal book reading app.
Output: one square 1024x1024 opaque image. Production icon art itself, edge-to-edge square background; no pre-rounded corners, no frame, no text, no Chinese characters, no letters, no watermark, no device or presentation board, no extra icon samples. Centered strong silhouette readable at small app sizes, generous edge margins.
Primary request: An exquisite tactile layered-paper sculptural app icon, warm and richly dimensional with restrained craft.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed muted pale sage #DCE4D3, subtly illuminated.
Subject: A compact sculptural emblem of a curled, upright book page transformed into one large pointed bamboo leaf, assembled from 4 broad folded paper layers. The page folds nest into a gentle S-shaped curl and cast soft short shadows; a second smaller ivory folded leaf creates a subtle open-book allusion at the base. An elegant organic silhouette, no whole tree and no background objects. The large bamboo leaf is deep forest green; supporting nested layers are mid sage and warm cream. Thick smooth paper edges, tangible depth without micro-detail.
Style/medium: high-quality 3D paper sculpture rendered from a near-front view with slight top angle, clean orthographic camera, soft ambient occlusion, matte premium paper, refined natural folds. Delicate soft upper-left studio light; dimensional but simple, no excessive floating layers.
Composition: one isolated central sculpture about 66% of canvas height, perfectly balanced margins, corners remain background. Sophisticated app-icon craft, visible broad plane changes at small size.
Color palette: pale sage background #DCE4D3, forest-green #315B46, warm cream #FFF1D8, mid sage #8AA77B, small warm terracotta paper edge accent.
Avoid: typography, borders, a rounded-square tile sitting on another background, ink brush texture, glossy glass, chrome, excessive thin page edges, photoreal desk, floating magical sparkles, literal open-book with tall sprouting branch.
